question: How does every action become offering to the supreme lord?
premises: knowing the stated order transforms indra-god offering into supreme-lord offering
every other action too becomes great-lord self-worship
whatever one does eating offers gives or practices austerity should be done as offering to me
inference: all action is gathered into supreme-lord worship through recognition
uncertainties: fused sandhi surfaces kept as single rows
plain_english: Thus, one who knows in the stated order finds even an offering to Indra and other gods to be an offering to the supreme lord; every other action too becomes worship of the great lord as one's own self. Therefore whatever you do, eat, offer, give, or practice as austerity, O son of Kunti, do that as an offering to me.
